data.name: Kissrim
data.detailed_description:
“Kissrim” is a choice-based visual novel.

Story

One late night, on his way home from the station to his apartment,

the protagonist hears the sound of a girl crying under the bridge.

Although the area isn’t particularly unsafe,
it’s certainly not a safe place for a girl to be alone at such an hour.

Unable to ignore it, the protagonist makes his way down beneath the bridge.

There, he finds a succubus curled up inside a cardboard box, hugging her knees.

Through her tears, she begs him to let her perform an energy drain (life-force absorption).

The protagonist reaches out his hand and says:
"If you don’t mind me, I’ll help you however I can."

And so begins the two of them’s shared life together.

Character

▶Lily Azura Kisquil Lira

CV: Yui Misono

A succubus striving to carry out energy-draining activities in the human world.

However, she is far too afraid of men to do so, and as a result has been unable to drain anyone at all.
Because of this, she’s on the verge of being cast out from the succubus group she belongs to.

Though she tells herself, “I have to try my best…!”,

whenever she actually approaches a man, she panics and ends up running away.

Her personality is gentle and caring, the type to devote herself wholeheartedly to others.

But perhaps due to her succubus instincts,
when she does drain energy she unexpectedly slips into a provocative tone, revealing a hidden teasing side.

Her favorite drink is milk.

Feature

  • Smooth character animations powered by E-mote

  • High-quality event CG

Staff

  • Character Design: 天音るり

  • Scenario: K.baggio

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Microsoft Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-10100Y / AMD Ryzen 3 3250U or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 615 / NVIDIA GeForce GT 1030 / AMD Radeon Pro 555 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectSound compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Pointing device required. DirectX 11 (Feature Level 11.0) or higher is required. Frame rates may drop on mobile processors during high-load scenes or when using upscaling features. Audio stuttering or display lag may occur when running on HDD, eMMC, or SATA 2.0 SSDs due to insufficient data read speeds. High-speed storage (NVMe SSD or SATA 3.0 SSD) is recommended for a smooth experience.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Microsoft Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GT 1030 (GDDR5) or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectSound compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Pointing device required. DirectX 11 (Feature Level 11.0) or higher is required. Frame rates may drop on mobile processors during high-load scenes or when using upscaling features. Audio stuttering or display lag may occur when running on HDD, eMMC, or SATA 2.0 SSDs due to insufficient data read speeds. High-speed storage (NVMe SSD or SATA 3.0 SSD) is recommended for a smooth experience.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains suggestive sexual content but does not include explicit depictions.
All characters involved in any implicit sexual content are over the age of 18.
